_about: Presentation only. NOT hashed into ContentDatabase.ContentVersion, so editing this file never retires a guild dungeon replay. Read by Assets/Scripts/Battle/VfxDirector.cs through VfxConfig. Resolution for a hit: abilities[abilityId], else types[the ability's vfx tag], else types.impact. An entry with a sheet that exists on disk plays that flipbook; otherwise its shape/chips/streaks/speed/size/life/ring numbers play as a procedural burst. To add art: put the sheet under Assets/Resources, add an abilities entry with sheet (Resources path, no extension), columns, rows, frames, fps, scale. No code change. Shapes are neutral and are tinted by the attacker's aspect accent; nothing here may be element-literal (DESIGN-ART-BIBLE section 4).
